cim: Jennifer Miller to Serve on Connie's Artificial Intelligence Evaluation Committee (AIEC)
cim_eredeti: Jennifer Miller to Serve on Connie's Artificial Intelligence Evaluation Committee (AIEC)
szoveg_eredeti:
Jennifer E. Miller, PhD, associate professor of medicine (general medicine) and co-director of the Program for Biomedical Ethics, has been invited to serve on the Artificial Intelligence Evaluation Committee (AIEC) for Connie, Connecticut's Health Information Exchange (HIE).

Established in 2019, Connie oversees and advances services that support the secure exchange of health information across Connecticut. Authorized by state statute, Connie provides the infrastructure necessary to improve healthcare delivery, quality, safety, and value for healthcare organizations, providers, and residents throughout the state.

Artificial intelligence presents significant opportunities to enhance the services Connie provides in support of clinical care, operational efficiency, and consumer empowerment. At the same time, AI introduces risks that must be carefully evaluated, managed, and monitored to ensure its responsible and trustworthy use. The AIEC is a key component of Connie's AI governance framework and will play a critical role in guiding the safe and responsible evaluation and application of AI technologies.

The Committee will be chaired by Dr. Allen Hsiao, chief health information officer for Yale New Haven Health and Yale School of Medicine.
